_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 01 완료 시제의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 3과 완료시제 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 현재완료는 과거를 나타내는 말과 함께 쓸 수 없다

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 (A), (B)를 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • They haven’t (A) [[have]] any trouble so far.
• She’s (B) [[find]] her missing wallet, so she’s using it.

choices.text: have — find
have — found
had — found
had — being found
been had — being found

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 (A), (B)를 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • Before I left home, I (B) [[lock]] all the doors.

choices.text: was living — has locked
was living — had locked
has lived — has locked
has been living — had locked
has been living — has locked

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장 두 개를 고르세요.

choices.text: Has Sora calling you recently?
I have never broken a promise.
He has lost his passport at the station.
Mia has learned to swim last summer.
The nurse has been caring for the patient since four hours.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장 두 개를 고르세요.

choices.text: When have you come back from your trip?
She has lost interest in that game.
My uncle has just make vegetable soup.
Sora didn’t enjoy the book because she had read it before.
Jake has living in the same town since he was a child.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. (단, 완료 시제를 사용할 것)
body: 나는 방금 병원에서 돌아왔다. (come back, the hospital, just, from)
questions.answer: have just come back from the hospital

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. (단, 완료 시제를 사용할 것)
body: 우리 어머니는 은퇴하시기 전에는 간호사로 일하셨다. (as, a nurse, work)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.
body: 내가 역에 도착했을 때, 기차는 막 떠났었다.

choices.text: The train just left when I arrived at the station.
The train has just left when I arrived at the station.
The train just left when I have arrived at the station.
The train had just left when I arrived at the station.
The train had just left when I have arrived at the station.

questions.point_label: when은 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없다
questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸 (A)~(E)에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: • ____(A)____ have you been staying in Rome?
• Sora has watched videos ____(C)____ this afternoon.

choices.text: (A) How long
(B) yet
(C) since
(D) ever
(E) When

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 현재완료진행 시제로 바꿀 수 없는 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I [[have waited]] for the bus for an hour.
Mina [[has practiced]] the violin for two hours.
I [[have volunteered]] at the shelter since last spring.
Jake [[has chatted]] with his cousin for an hour.
We [[have known]] the answer since this morning.

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I lost the umbrella you [[had lent]] me.
Did you hear what [[had happened]] to Mina?
He [[had gone]] to bed before the storm began.
Sora had already left when I [[had arrived]] at the café.
My brother had a headache after he [[had studied]] too long.

questions.prompt: 다음 지호의 여행 일정표를 보고 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Jiho tried street food after he had watched a musical.
Jiho had bought presents before he tried street food.
Jiho had visited the old palace before he bought presents.
Jiho had watched a musical after he visited the old palace.
Jiho bought presents after he had watched a musical.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 완료 시제를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰세요.
body: Sumin started learning Spanish in 2021. She still learns it.
questions.answer: Sumin has learned[has been learning] Spanish since 2021

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 완료 시제를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰세요.
body: My grandmother moved to Jeju. She ran a bakery for 15 years.
questions.answer: my grandmother moved to Jeju, she had run a bakery for 15 years

questions.prompt: 다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어법상 어색한 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: A: Have you finished all of the homework?  B: No, I’ve done only half of it.
A: How long have you worked here?  B: I had worked here since 2019.
A: Have you ever been to a baseball game?  B: No, I’ve never been there.
A: Mina, I haven’t seen you for ages.  B: Oh, Jiho! How have you been?
A: Have you fed the dog already?  B: Sorry, Mom. I completely forgot.

body: <조건> • 현재완료진행 시제를 사용할 것  • the prices, rise, last month를 사용하여 쓸 것  • 여덟 단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The prices have been rising since last month
